lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Web 2 to long lower flange 4, about 56 deg. In sections at 25/50/75% the label apex sits on the outer skin (nearest point 0.03 to 0.24 mm, outer-apex dy at most 0.06 mm). The occupancy within 0.8 mm runs exactly over t 0 to 217 and stops at both ends: the relief curve at the left, the plate end at the right.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Web to upper strip 7, about 50 deg. Apex on the outer skin at all three stations (at most 0.11 mm). The line runs from the relief slot to the strip's chamfered end. The occupancy at t < -4 is the flat web under the extended line, not a fold: plate 5 is parallel to strip 7 but offset 6.9 mm, and its fold line is 7.8 to 8.2 mm off B2's axis. So B3 is a separate fold, correctly kept as its own line.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Web to left end plate 5, about 50 deg, a distinct fold axis (see B2). Apex on the outer skin (at most 0.11 mm). Extent runs from the B8 flange corner to the relief slot, with occupancy confined to t 0 to 43.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Web to right-end down flange 15, 90 deg, flange about 8 mm deep. Apex on the outer round (at most 0.22 mm). Sections at frac -0.15, 1.12 and 1.25 show the web ending at the edge with no flange, so the holed lug past the end is not folded and the extent is correct.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Small holed tab 17, bent about 88 deg from the end edge of the web step. Sections show a clear 90 deg fold with the apex on the outer skin (at most 0.07 mm). The 8.5 mm line spans the tab's full width.

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: Web lower edge (left end) to short wall 14, 90 deg. Apex on the outer skin (at most 0.13 mm). It is a separate fold from B1 (90 vs 56 deg, separated by a relief). The extent runs from the small relief at the B8 corner to the wall end, and the 0.8 mm occupancy stops at t 22.5.

lines.label: B7
lines.reason: Short wall 11/14 to holed tab 9, about 40 deg (well above 10 deg). The sections show the wall-to-tab crease clearly, with the apex on the outer skin (at most 0.21 mm). It spans the full 23.6 mm tab width.

lines.label: B8
lines.reason: Web left end edge to end flange 13, 90 deg, flange about 8 mm deep. Apex on the outer round (at most 0.16 mm). The extent covers the full 28 mm flange between plate 5's corner and the wall/tab corner.
